skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 800% ATK DMG to all targets. Adds [Specialized Charge] DMG equal to the number of targets hit × 250% ATK. Removes the enemy team’s [Specialized Fear] Energy.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 1000% ATK DMG to all targets. Adds [Specialized Charge] DMG equal to the number of targets hit × 325% ATK. Removes the enemy team’s [Specialized Fear] Energy.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Permanently gains 100% [Injury Boost]. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility]. [Injury Boost]: Increases [Injury], [Internal Injury], and [Charge] DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Permanently gains 125% [Injury Boost]. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility]. [Injury Boost]: Increases [Injury], [Internal Injury], and [Charge] DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. Permanently gains 150% [Injury Boost]. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of non-critical DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility]. [Injury Boost]: Increases [Injury], [Internal Injury], and [Charge] DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Before battle begins, [Encourage] allies and permanently grants all allies [Specialized DMG Reflect]. Increases own [Instant DMG Accuracy] by 50%. [Encourage]: Gains 2 Energy at the start of each round for 3 rounds. [Specialized DMG Reflect]: Reduces Direct DMG and Additional DMG received by 50%, and returns 50% of the original DMG to the attacker as Extra DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Before battle begins, [Encourage] allies and permanently grants all allies [Specialized DMG Reflect]. Increases own [Instant DMG Accuracy] by 70%. [Encourage]: Gains 3 Energy at the start of each round for 5 rounds. [Specialized DMG Reflect]: Reduces Direct DMG and Additional DMG received by 70%, and returns 70% of the original DMG to the attacker as Extra DMG.
